title: Claude AI — Subscription Economics
description: True compute cost vs plan cost vs VC subsidy. Shows what you'd pay at API retail rates, what your plan costs (prorated), and how much Anthropic investors are absorbing. Set time range to 30d for monthly comparison. Adjust "Billing Days" variable to match your selected range.

list.name: plan_monthly_cost
list.label: Plan ($/mo)
list.description: Your Claude subscription tier. Controls plan cost used in all subsidy calculations.

list.name: billing_days
list.label: Billing Days in Range
list.description: Number of days in your selected time range. Used to prorate the monthly plan cost. Default 30 = full month. Set to 7 if you selected a 7-day window.

panels.title: True Cost vs Plan Cost
panels.description: True Cost = API retail price for every token consumed. Plan Cost = your flat subscription (prorated to selected window). The gap = VC subsidy. Adjust "Billing Days" to match your time range.

panels.title: True Cost (API Retail)
panels.description: What you would pay at Anthropic's published API rates if there were no subscription plan. This is your actual compute consumption cost.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Your Plan Cost (Prorated)
panels.description: Your flat Claude subscription cost prorated to the selected time window. Formula: plan_monthly / 30 × billing_days. Adjust the "Billing Days" variable to match your selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: VC Subsidy Covering You
panels.description: True API Cost minus prorated plan cost. Positive = Anthropic investors are covering your excess compute costs. Negative = you're under-utilizing your plan for this window.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Subsidy Multiplier
panels.description: API retail cost ÷ prorated plan cost. 1.0 = break even. 3.6 = you got $3.60 of compute per $1 paid. Higher = more VC subsidy.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: You Pay (¢ per $1 API)
panels.description: Your plan cost as a percentage of API retail cost. 28% = you paid 28 cents for every $1 of compute. Lower % = bigger VC subsidy.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Annualized VC Subsidy
panels.description: If current subsidy rate continued for a full year. (True Cost − Plan Cost) / billing_days × 365.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: What Would Claude Cost Without VC Funding?

options.content:
## What Would Claude Cost Without VC Funding?

Without Anthropic's $7.3B in investor capital, you would pay **retail API prices** directly — exactly what the "True Cost (API Retail)" stat shows above.

**Anthropic's actual economics (2024–2025):**
- Gross margin: **−94% in 2024** → investors covered $0.94 of every $1 of API revenue in compute costs
- Annual investor burn: ~**$3 billion** keeping inference prices below true cost
- Max plan subscribers consumed **$1,000–$5,000/day** at API retail vs $100/month subscription
- Your **Subsidy Multiplier** tells you: for every $1 you paid, how many $1 of API compute did you receive?

**The subsidy shrinks over time:**
- Hardware efficiency + model compression drops inference cost ~**10x per year**
- Anthropic projects **77% gross margin by 2028** — API retail prices will reflect true cost by then
- When that happens, subscription plans will either cost more or throttle heavy users

**Bottom line:** The gap between "True Cost" and "Your Plan Cost" is exactly what VC capital is absorbing right now. The "Missed Usage Opportunity" chart shows which days you left plan value on the table vs which days VCs covered your compute.
